# Bubbled
**Bubble your items and send them home instantly!**

A lightweight utility mod that lets you magically bubble up dropped items and teleport them back to a designated "home point" using a bubble wand.

---

## ✨ | Features

- **Bubble Wand** — A magical tool that lets you collect loose items with style
- **Bubble Items** — Right-click dropped items to encase them in bubbles
- **Designated Return Point** — Crouch + right-click any block to set a permanent "bubble home" attached to your bubble wand
- **Instant Delivery** — Bubble items and send them straight to your chosen return point

Perfect for mining sessions, mob farms, item sorting, or just making item collection less of a hassle!

---

## 📖 | Usage

1. **Craft the Bubble Wand**
   - **Recipe:** Two sticks + an emerald diagonally with the emerald in the top right corner of the crafting table.
2. **Set Your Bubble Point**
   - Crouch + Right-click any block with the wand
   - This becomes your item return destination
3. **Bubble Items**
   - Right-click on dropped items to bubble them up
   - Multiple items can be in the same bubble (as long as they're the same item)
4. **Send Them Home**
   - Right-click the bubbles (with or without the wand) to send them flying back to their destination. (works across dimensions)

Bubbled items are safely stored in the bubble until you decide to send (or pop) them.

---

## 🎨 | Gallery

Click the "Gallery" button at the top of the project page to view photos.

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft**: 1.20.1 *(1.21.1 coming soon)*
- **Forge + NeoForge** 

---

## Installation

1. Install Forge 1.20.1
2. Download Bubbled from Modrinth
3. Drop the `.jar` into your `mods` folder

Enjoy cleaner inventory management and magical item transport!

---
